evidence: Film thickness was determined post-deposition using X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) on a Bruker D8 diﬀractometer using Cu K α radiation. Cross-sectional scanning electron microscopy (cross-SEM) was used to estimate ﬁlm thickness on ﬁlms that were not suited for X-ray reﬂectivity, using a FEI Quanta 200F high-vacuum electron microscope. Film thickness was characterised in-situ by spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE). Film composition was examined using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and time-of-ﬂight elastic recoil detection (ToF-ERD). In-situ infrared spectroscopy during the deposition process was performed on an FTIR spectrometer. The ellipsometer used was a J.A. Woollam M-2000. ToF-ERD was performed using a home-built spectrometer. In-situ FTIR was used during initial-stage ALD and inhibited-stage growth modes.
